parsed.name: PI E-709压电定位控制器
parsed.description: 用于控制双通道或XY压电定位平台的运动控制器，可执行绝对/相对移动、伺服闭环控制、位置读取、到位判断和参考初始化，常用于显微成像中的纳米级定位与扫描。
parsed.description_en: A motion controller for dual-channel or XY piezo positioning stages. It supports absolute/relative moves, closed-loop servo control, position readback, on-target checks, and reference initialization, commonly used for nanoscale positioning and scanning in microscopy.

actions.description: 关闭与压电控制器的通信连接。
actions.description_en: Close the communication connection to the piezo controller.

actions.description: 设置伺服闭环控制状态。
actions.description_en: Set the closed-loop servo control state.

actions.description: 重新初始化控制器，并可选择执行参考定位流程。
actions.description_en: Reinitialize the controller and optionally run the reference-finding procedure.

actions.description: 将指定通道移动到绝对目标位置。
actions.description_en: Move the specified channel to an absolute target position.

actions.description: 使指定通道相对当前位置移动指定增量。
actions.description_en: Move the specified channel by a relative increment from its current position.

actions.description: 查询设备是否已到达目标位置。
actions.description_en: Query whether the device has reached its target position.

actions.description: 读取指定通道的当前位置。
actions.description_en: Read the current position of the specified channel.

actions.description: 读取XY两个通道的当前位置。
actions.description_en: Read the current positions of the X and Y channels.

actions.description: 读取指定通道的目标位置。
actions.description_en: Read the target position of the specified channel.

actions.description: 按给定方向分量驱动XY轴运动。
actions.description_en: Drive the XY axes in the specified direction components.

actions.description: 查询控制器是否已准备好接收控制命令。
actions.description_en: Query whether the controller is ready to accept control commands.

actions.description: 查询通道对象标识或配置。
actions.description_en: Query the channel object identifier or configuration.

actions.description: 查询指定通道的最小允许位置。
actions.description_en: Query the minimum allowed position for the specified channel.

actions.description: 查询指定通道的最大允许位置。
actions.description_en: Query the maximum allowed position for the specified channel.
